concepts.def: Italian city where the play is set.
Play that ends in serious loss.

walkthroughs.body_html: Romeo and Juliet was written by William Shakespeare around 1597. It's one of his most performed tragedies.
The play is set in Verona, Italy. Streets, a ball, a balcony and a tomb provide the key settings.
The Capulets (Juliet's family) and the Montagues (Romeo's family) carry an 'ancient grudge' — the feud drives the tragedy.
